## Behavioral tradeoffs

- **local_faction_encounters / simulation_improvement**: Gate encounter staging by authored physical area and station-relative speed; protect busy actors and preserve existing patrol motion. Native caps and commands remain authoritative. Removes: Interplanetary convoy staging.; Busy-actor recruitment and velocity overwrite.. Preserves: Native event weights, severity, actor cap accounting and ordinary patrol execution..
- **patrol_priority_and_persistence / bugfix**: Use native ordinary Navy patrol missions; retain one-shot callbacks and saved FIFO; migrate only an isolated legacy Navy patrol. Removes: Ambient patrol starvation of native emergency branches.; One-shot wrapper loss and reversed waiting commands.. Preserves: Native urgent/scripted queues and combat policy.; Target, native flight/fuel state and mixed legacy scripts..

## Dependencies not transition-expanded

- **combat_cleanup_admission**: Native Navy/Blockade detection failure writes InCombat=false before neutralization; sticky Main resumes against the old enemy. Constructor-local stateless ConditionCommand adapters execute each original gate and admit pending Combatants to native cleanup and station selection. No invented enemies, forced home or saved fields. Dedicated shipped-assembly tests establish baseline and production contrast. Full combat remains outside this staging projection. Separate acquisition repair now also covers Blockade; see COMBAT-NEUTRALIZATION.md and Navigation/PATROL-TARGET-HANDOFF.md.
- **disabled_target_acquisition**: Both detectors exclude new AI-marked below-Full targets without a controller, matching native IsTargetNeutralized. Existing Combatants retain native cleanup; Full/manual and non-AI targets stay eligible. Blockade warnings, faction rules, range and reentry remain native; registration restoration is immediately observable. Tests execute baseline and production detector/cleanup paths, including mixed fights and IL drift. No replacement behavior controller or signature-cache mutation. See Navigation/COMBAT-NEUTRALIZATION.md.
- **shallow_flight_control_handoff**: Native-tested autonomous FlyTo RCS/pause, explicit TorchOff and direct RCS commands release unowned shallow AI torch input. Active NavData excludes direct-actuator cleanup. Changed escape/retreat destinations stop obsolete controls. Momentum, fuel, new RCS input, active courses and physical/player control paths are preserved. No affordability gate or new rescue policy. Numerical flight remains external; see Navigation/FLIGHT-CONTROL-HANDOFF.md.

These unresolved boundaries prevent calling this an all-patches effective simulation. Native inner/outer Harmony phases and side effects must be expanded before drawing conclusions across them.
